gold_findings.reason: retry_limit has no upper bound, so arbitrarily oversized nonnegative integers are emitted in a simulated policy record despite the stated rejection of oversized numeric guard values.

cases.adjudication_reason: Both independent adjudicators agreed that the two token reads create a cache partition race.

gold_findings.reason: The tooltip label now directly uses rejectionReason without a fallback, allowing missing or empty rejection reasons to produce an unusable blank tooltip.

gold_findings.reason: compileall is invoked without suppressing bytecode generation, so a health check can create scripts/__pycache__ artifacts and dirty the working tree.

reassessment.reason: --fast intentionally skips slow checks under the current health contract.
